  WHY: On a runner where a different version of these packages is already present (or where a transitive dep conflict exists), the install can silently change the package set seen by later steps or tests, producing non-reproducible CI outcomes.

  WHY: A transient `pip` failure (network blip, PyPI 5xx, rate-limit, etc.) will abort the entire `validate-scripts` job, causing the release gate to fail even though the underlying test bug that motivated the PR has been fixed. The original release failure was exactly this class of fragility.
